about: Per-asset file spans and block cursors recorded from the game's own loader (t5mp.elf Load_XAsset run in a PowerPC interpreter) over nine inflated zones. Numbers only. Assets are contiguous: asset i starts where i-1 ends, with i-1's cursors. 'sizes' are file byte counts per asset, 'deltas' the 7 block-cursor changes per asset (flattened).
